description: Experience the iconic tangy flavor and chewy texture of a true San Francisco Sourdough Boule. This traditional American bread boasts a beautifully crisp crust and a soft, airy crumb. Perfect for sandwiches, toast, or alongside your favorite meal.

instructions.title: Mix the Dough
instructions.text: In a large bowl, combine the active sourdough starter and warm water. Mix until the starter is mostly dissolved. Add the bread flour, whole wheat flour, and salt. Mix with your hands or a Danish dough whisk until no dry flour remains and a shaggy dough forms. Cover the bowl and let rest for 30 minutes for autolyse.

instructions.title: Perform Stretch and Folds
instructions.text: Over the next 2-3 hours, perform 3-4 sets of stretch and folds every 30-45 minutes. To do this, lightly wet your hands, grab a portion of the dough, gently stretch it upwards, and fold it over itself. Rotate the bowl and repeat 3-4 times per set. This builds gluten strength.

instructions.title: Bulk Fermentation
instructions.text: After the stretch and folds, cover the bowl and allow the dough to bulk ferment at room temperature for another 3-6 hours, depending on your ambient temperature and starter activity. The dough should increase in volume by about 20-30% and feel airy.

instructions.title: Shape the Boule
instructions.text: Gently turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface. Gently pre-shape it into a round and let it rest for 20 minutes. Then, perform a final shaping by creating tension on the surface to form a tight boule. Transfer the shaped dough seam-side up into a floured banneton or a bowl lined with a floured kitchen towel.

instructions.title: Cold Proof
instructions.text: Cover the banneton with plastic wrap or a shower cap and refrigerate for 12-18 hours. This slow cold proof develops flavor and makes the dough easier to score. Preheat your oven with a Dutch oven inside to 500F (260C) for at least 30 minutes before baking.

instructions.title: Bake the Sourdough
instructions.text: Carefully remove the hot Dutch oven from the oven. Gently invert the dough from the banneton into the Dutch oven. Score the top of the dough with a sharp lame or razor blade. Cover and bake for 20 minutes. Remove the lid, reduce the oven temperature to 450F (230C), and bake for another 15-20 minutes until the crust is deeply golden brown.

instructions.title: Cool Completely
instructions.text: Carefully remove the boule from the Dutch oven and transfer it to a wire rack to cool completely for at least 1-2 hours before slicing. Slicing too early will result in a gummy texture.

tips: Ensure your sourdough starter is active and bubbly before beginning, as this is crucial for a good rise and open crumb structure.
For the best crust, bake in a preheated Dutch oven or on a baking stone with a pan of hot water for steam in the first part of baking.
Always allow your sourdough boule to cool completely on a wire rack before slicing to prevent a gummy texture and ensure the crumb sets properly.
